insights: The design system uses a strict monochromatic palette with #000000 for text and #040404 (Pure Black) for heavy UI surfaces, creating deep contrast against white/light backgrounds
Glassmorphism is a core visual pattern using 'frost-white-intense' classes with backdrop-blur for product cards and navigation overlays, creating depth without sacrificing readability

Button radius varies intentionally by context: rounded-md (6px) for product CTAs, rounded-lg (8px) for location selector, and rounded-none for cookie consent modal buttons - suggesting legacy third-party components vs native design system
